Jamie — thank you, received and reviewed quickly. Looping in Rishi (legal) and Camila (contracts) to confirm final signoff flow.

Quick answers / next steps:
1) Proposed DocuSign envelope sequence: 
   - Step 1: Redwood (signature by Head of Revenue Ops) — we generally sign first to lock the Redwood effective date.
   - Step 2: Atlas Health CFO (final financial sign-off).
   - Step 3: Atlas Health GC (legal countersign).
   - Final: System-generated clean PDF delivered to all recipients on completion.

2) Please confirm the individual names/titles for the CFO and GC who will sign. Your Signer_Authority_Attestation helps but we need the specific email addresses to populate the envelope.

3) Attachments: we'll route the MSA redline through Legal for the narrow data-retention point; Camila will prepare the envelope and include a checkbox workflow for the Order Form SOW acceptance.

Can you confirm you want Redwood to sign first (we recommend this to avoid effective-date churn)? If yes, Camila and I will assemble the envelope and aim to send by EOD tomorrow PST.

Thanks, team. I reviewed the attached MSA_Atlas_Redline_v3.pdf. Two small items from Legal before we assemble the envelope:

1) Data retention (Sec 8.2): We accept the change but need an explicit 30-day export window in the Order Form (practical step) so customer can retrieve logs if requested — Camila, can you add a short clause in the Order Form SOW?
2) Authorization proof: The Signer_Authority_Attestation is good; please confirm the signer's title and that the attestation includes the authority to bind. We must attach that PDF to the envelope per our internal audit.

On routing: Redwood can sign first. A few operational notes for DocuSign envelope settings:
- Signing order: Redwood -> Atlas CFO -> Atlas GC.
- Audit trail required: include signer IP and time stamps (DocuSign default) and attach the attestation as required evidence.
- Clean copy distribution: add legal@atlashealth.com and camila_reyes@redwood.com to the post-execution recipients list.

Camila: once you prepare the envelope, please include the final clean copy workflow (one-click export in PDF) and mark the envelope with custom field DEAL: RDW-4521. I will do a final legal stamp prior to sending if anything material changed.

Rishi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
